A.title: Document Change Branch and Merge contracts

hardCaps.publicInvariant: Applied revisions are gapless and a conflicted Change never partially mutates blocks or events.
One branch-local client sequence and one idempotency identity preserve one durable semantic response.
A reviewed merge either creates exactly one captured target revision or becomes stale with no target mutation.
A Snapshot covers its exact immutable operation prefix and stale Work ownership cannot publish.
V1 identities, histories, replay bodies, assets, Work and Events survive the main-branch migration.

specGaps.summary: The contract requires terminalAt but does not define its state-specific nullability.
The migration contract does not define the generated main Branch identity and timestamp.
